answer: To resist sybils%2C agents lock a copper stake into the harbor only after completing a sequential karst puzzle derived from the prior block hash. An attacker running 500 clones must finish 500 separate karst chains in series%2C paying roughly 500× the compute of one honest agent%2C because each solution depends on the previous. Honest agents solve one per epoch. The scheme fails if the harbor accepts parallelized proofs or if copper locks can be pooled without sequential dependency.
